message: Running command: grep -rn "VarSizedBinSearchArrayOf" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/harfbuzz/src/hb-open-type.hh | head && echo "---" && grep -rn "struct VarSizedBinSearchArrayOf" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/harfbuzz/src/

message.content:
The vulnerability is a use-of-uninitialized-value in `LookupSegmentSingle<T>::cmp` when called from `bsearch` in `LookupFormat2<T>::get_value`. This is in the AAT (Apple Advanced Typography) layout code. The `cmp` function reads `first` and `last` fields which may be uninitialized if the binary search reads beyond the valid data.

Let me look at the `VarSizedBinSearchArrayOf` and `bsearch` implementation, and understand how the fuzzer input is structured (hb-shape-fuzzer takes a font file as input).
